title: sh.fx extensions to the Agent Client Protocol, version 1
description: Draft. The types that sh-fx.md defines. The standard ACP types are in acp/v1/schema.json.

MethodName.description: The name of an sh.fx method or notification: `_sh.fx/` followed by `<area>/<action>` in snake_case.

CapabilityName.description: The name of an sh.fx capability: `sh.fx/` followed by a camelCase name.

MetaKey.description: An sh.fx key in a `_meta` object: `sh.fx/` followed by a camelCase name.

Capability.description: The value of an sh.fx capability entry. It stays empty unless the extension defines options. Peers ignore fields they don't know.

AgentCapabilitiesMeta.description: The sh.fx entries that fx lists in `agentCapabilities._meta` of its `initialize` response.

ClientCapabilitiesMeta.description: The sh.fx entries that a client lists in `clientCapabilities._meta` of its `initialize` request.

PromptDeliveryCapability.description: The value of the sh.fx/promptDelivery capability that fx lists: one entry for each delivery that fx supports.

PromptDelivery.description: The value of sh.fx/delivery in the `_meta` of a `session/prompt` request: what fx does with a prompt that arrives while a turn runs.

SteeringDelivery.description: The value of sh.fx/steeringDelivery in the `_meta` of the response to a steer: whether the running turn took the steer, or the steer ran in the next turn.

SteerInput.description: The value of sh.fx/steerInput in the `_meta` of a `user_message_chunk` update that shows a steer.

requestId.description: The request id of the `session/prompt` that sent the steer, or null for a host steer.

inputId.description: The input id of a host steer.
